title: Taylor Swift's Big Cheer: 'That's My Husband!'
summary:
Have you ever been so excited for someone you jumped out of your seat? That's exactly what Taylor Swift did on Sunday. Her husband, Travis Kelce, scored his first touchdown of the 2026 NFL season, and Swift went wild in her suite at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri.

Cameras caught the pop star pointing at her wedding ring and appearing to say, "That's my husband." Even NBC announcer Mike Tirico joined in: "And the woman with the ring. That's your guy!"

Swift wore a sleeveless red Chiefs shirt and blue jeans. She watched the game with her parents, Scott and Andrea Swift. The Chiefs beat the Indianapolis Colts 33-30 in overtime.

It was Swift's second week in a row cheering at a Chiefs game. The week before, she was spotted chatting with Tom Cruise. Cruise later told Jimmy Fallon that Swift was "schooling" him on football. "She's a genius," he said.

Kelce agreed. On his podcast New Heights, he laughed about how Swift used to think players were "basically out there boxing each other on the field." Now? She calls out penalties like encroachment. "She's on it now," Kelce said. "She fully engulfed in it."
why_it_matters: It shows that even superstars can start out knowing nothing about something new and end up learning it well — and that cheering for your family is something everyone understands.

background_read: Taylor Swift (one of the most famous pop singers in the world) is married to Travis Kelce (a star player for the Kansas City Chiefs).
The Chiefs play in the NFL (the National Football League — the biggest professional American football league, with games in the fall and winter).
A touchdown is worth six points and is one of the most exciting ways to score, and overtime (extra time when the score is tied) is even more dramatic.
Tom Cruise (a famous movie actor) and Jimmy Fallon (a TV host with a late-night comedy show) both talked about watching Swift learn about football.
Article_Structure: WHO: Taylor Swift, her husband Travis Kelce, and the Kansas City Chiefs, plus people like Mike Tirico, Tom Cruise and Jimmy Fallon who talked about it
WHAT: Swift jumped up and pointed at her wedding ring, seeming to say 'That's my husband,' after Kelce scored his first touchdown of the season
WHERE: A suite at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri — and later on Kelce's podcast New Heights
WHY: The story shows how Swift went from knowing almost nothing about football to calling out penalties like encroachment

perspectives.description: They love seeing her jump up, show off her wedding ring and act like any excited family member in the stands.
They might think the TV cameras spend too much time on a celebrity in a suite instead of on the players making big plays.
They seem happy about it, joking on the podcast about how quickly Swift learned the rules and how into the game she is now.
